sentences.text: 2. A perusal of the averments made in the writ petition indicates that the Collector's award determining the compensation is dated 30.12.1992.
In a vague manner, in paragraph No.'3.5' of the writ petition, it is stated that the petitioners immediately filed reference under Section 18 of the Act for getting proper compensation amount.

A copy of the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/16438/2019 ORDER DATED: 06/10/2025 undefined reference allegedly filed by the petitioners under Section 18 of Act, 1894 is annexed at "Annexure E" to the writ petition.
3. A persual of the Annexure 'E' at page No.'23' of the paper-book indicates that it is an undated document.
There is no proof of filing of the said document alleged as reference application in the office of the Collector concerned.
There is no indication of the date on which the alleged reference application has been filed.
Also, there is no explanation as to why the petitioners would wait for a period of 37 years to approach this Court.

Section 18 of the Act, 1894 requires adhereing to the time line as prescribed in Sub-section (2) of Section 18 for making of reference to the Court, by a person who is dissatisfied with the determination of compensation made by the Collector under Section 11 of the Act, 1894.

4. Taking note of the above, we do not find any good ground to issue mandamus to the respondent-authorities to consider the application for allegedly filed by the petitioners for making reference under Section 18 of the Act.
The present petition is accordingly, dismissed.
